headline: Escaping Systems: Architecture Beyond Familiar Ground
context: Cities depend on systems that already exist around them. When architects design on water or beyond Earth , those systems are no longer available. Without fixed ground or nearby networks for energy, water, transport, and waste, architecture has to take on functions the larger city
